blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of Justice (DOJ) is supporting a nationwide shift toward standardized, “Anti-Epal” Persons with Disability (PWD) identification cards equipped with automated verification to dismantle a massive fake ID industry. Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida’s statement came after records from the National Council on Disability Affairs (NCDA) uncovered an almost 6 million discrepancy between the 2.8 million PWDs legitimately registered and an estimated 8.5 million individuals with an actual PWD identification card. Vida said the NCDA is rolling out a central, technology-driven verifiable system expected to be fully deployed over the next two to three years. The new ID […]...
